Prevention: Remove tender leaves to reduce cotton bollworm eggs.
Set up insect nets at ventilation openings of greenhouse.
Cotton bollworms are attracted to succulent, rank-growing plants; keep water, fertilizer, and plant density at recommended levels to avoid rank growth.
Monitoring: May using frequency- vibrancy pest-killing lamp to estimate the peak time of adult.
Check egg masses every three days in
June to estimate peak time of eggs.
Direct Control: Lure and kill adult using frequency- vibrancy pest-killing lamp.
Syrphid fly larvae are a good egg and small larvae predator.
Augmentation of egg parasites e.g., Trichogramma sp. is effective to keep population below economic injury level
Restrictions: Chemical pesticides must be applied strictly according to the prescribed dosages to avoid residue problems
Rotational application of pesticides to avoid resistance
PPEs is mandatory while using chemical pesticides
U (Unlikely to present acute hazard), Toxic to bees, PHI: 8 days
